posts.post: Friendly reminder that the suit you wear shouldn't apologize for your presence. STRAYED is for the man who no longer needs to blend in to be validated.
How to know if you're stuck: You are still waiting for permission to change the game. The market doesn't give permission. It only gives feedback.
Fun fact: Your wardrobe is the interface between your internal drive and external perception. If your clothes look average, people will assume your output is too.
